text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert PD-100112 fired for service=hosted-inference-prod severity=critical. Routing policy=prod-critical. Primary=jessica (oncall). Link: https://pagerduty.com/PD-100112 :rotating_light:

pd-bot: PD-100112 -> step 1: primary (jessica (oncall)) notified via push/sms/email. No ack observed after 120s. Escalating to secondary: dev-nate. SMS delivery attempt shows delayed status.

jessica (oncall): acking now, woke up to push. phone updated overnight so SMS might not have gone through. jumping on, creating bridge.

pd-bot: PD-100112 acknowledged by jessica (oncall) at 02:14 UTC. Note: escalation to secondary already in-flight due to PD timers. Manager escalation pending if secondary not ack within policy window.

dev-nate: got only email, no SMS (vendor ping returned 504). joining bridge. pulling logs and recent infra changes.

net-kara: metrics snapshot from observability -> 5xx spike and streaming truncations observed across us-west-2 and us-east-1 starting 02:08 UTC. `5xx_1m = 13.7%`, baseline ~0.25%.

cs-tom: support queue: 4 high-priority tickets flagged, two enterprise customers seeing truncated streams and timeouts. CS alerted account reps and opening incident advisory.

jessica (oncall): tail from edge/proxy logs:
```
2026-05-05T02:09:02Z ERROR proxy: req=aa1b22 502 "downstream-reset" endpoint=/v1/stream
2026-05-05T02:09:08Z ERROR serve: req=aa1b25 500 "kv-cache-alloc" model=redwood-13b
2026-05-05T02:09:12Z WARN queue: backlog=1020 avg_latency=240ms
```

dev-nate: I also see abnormal increase in kv_cache_evicts and memory pressure on a subset of hosts (hostpool-7). suspect a recent autoscaler adjustment plus a prefetch param bump.

jessica (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) enable conservative streaming limits 2) split traffic away from shared pool to dedicated-fallback 3) restart high-memory pods 4) may rollback config bump if metrics don't improve.

#1 tighten streaming limits:
```bash
redwood feature flag set --service hosted-inference-prod --flag streaming.max_concurrent_chunks=4 --env production
```

#2 traffic split to dedicated-fallback:
```bash
redwood traffic split --service hosted-inference-prod --add dedicated-fallback=40% --ttl 12m --reason "emergency shift to reduce shared pool load"
```

net-kara: applying traffic split now.

#3 restart high-memory pods in hostpool-7:
```bash
kubectl -n redwood delete pod -l hostpool=hostpool-7 --grace-period=5
```

pd-bot: PD-100112 -> escalation: manager escalation triggered because secondary ack delayed (PD escalation policy prod-critical). Manager notified: manager-irene.

manager-irene: joining bridge. what's the customer impact and ETA?

cs-tom: impact: ~10-20 minutes of elevated 5xx affecting streaming endpoints; several enterprise sessions interrupted. we're sending targeted updates; CS asked for timeline and root cause when available.

dev-nate: after traffic split + restarts + streaming limits: 5xx dropped from 13.7% -> 2.6% over 5m; queue backlog decreased 1020 -> 160. progress looks good.

jessica (oncall): running quick guard: set kv_cache.max_prefetch to safe-default and enable allocation limiter:
```bash
redwood config set --service hosted-inference-prod --key kv_cache.max_prefetch --value 150 --env production
redwood config set --service hosted-inference-prod --key kv_cache.alloc_limit_bytes --value 2147483648 --env production
```

net-kara: added temporary autoscaler bump for dedicated-fallback to handle 40% extra traffic.

manager-irene: good mitigation. action items: 1) RCA for kv cache growth vs prefetch/autoscaler changes 2) PD escalation review: SMS vendor failure & alternate notify channels 3) add early alert for kv cache growth and memory pressure 4) customer comms follow-up. assign owners?

jessica (oncall): I'll take #1 and produce timeline + RCA.

dev-nate: I'll take #3 (dashboards and alerts) and help with reproducer.

cs-tom: CS will own customer comms and advisory. I'll draft a post-incident message and coordinate with account teams.

pd-bot: PD-100112 resolved in PagerDuty by jessica (oncall) at 02:26 UTC after mitigations.

incidentbot: Incident PD-100112 closed in thread -> status: resolved. summary: transient kv-cache/memory pressure caused elevated 5xx and streaming truncation; mitigations included traffic split to dedicated fallback, pod restarts, streaming limits, and config rollback to safe prefetch. See ticket INC-2026-216 for postmortem and timeline. :white_check_mark:

manager-irene: please ensure postmortem documents the PD timeline especially the secondary SMS delay and manager escalation. evaluate adding a PD fallback step (email + push + Ops Slack ping) when SMS vendor reports degraded state.

jessica (oncall): noted, creating INC-2026-216 now. leaving bridge open for 25m for validation. thanks team. :thumbsup:
